items/momento-magica-8th-level-spell-494.name: Momento Magica, 8th-level spell
items/momento-magica-8th-level-spell-494.effectSummary: Once per day, this memento restores one 8th-level spell slot the user previously expended that day, making the slot available again as though it had not been used. It has no effect for spellcasters who prepare their spells.

items/eternal-wand-0-level-spell-395.name: Eternal Wand, 0-level spell
items/eternal-wand-0-level-spell-395.effectSummary: This eternal wand holds one 0-level arcane spell chosen when the item is created. Any character capable of casting arcane spells can activate the stored spell regardless of whether it appears on that character's class spell list, and the wand can be used twice per day.
